Italy
Kaylee, you did it! You won the Italy Explorer trophy!
Kaylee, Italy Explorer! From Italy.

text: Help me get ready to sing at the opera?

Tap the glowing pizza!
Where should we go next, Kaylee?
This spot opens soon!
Italy is shaped like a boot! Kick!
Lupa's opera night is coming soon!
Help friends to fill up Lupa's band!

text: Welcome to Naples! Pizza was born here!
Zio Bruno needs a helper chef!
Let me tell you the story of the most famous pizza!

Long ago, a queen named Margherita came to Naples.

text: For the Queen, I will make a special pizza!
Hello! I would love a pizza, please.

Flick the dough up to spin it!
Again! Flick it up!
Swirl the ladle to spread the sauce!
Tomatoes love the hot, sunny weather in Italy!
Put three pieces of white mozzarella on the pizza!
Now three green basil leaves!

text: Red, white and green, like the flag of Italy!

Slide the pizza into the oven!
This oven is super hot! Pizza bakes in ninety seconds!
Tap the pizza to turn it!
Turn it again!
It is golden! Pull the pizza out!
Tap the pizza to give it to the Queen!

text: So we call it pizza Margherita!
Fresh mozzarella, from my family's milk!

Mozzarella is made from milk. Some comes from buffalo!
Tap the order to start!
Put five olives on the pizza!
One!
Two!
Three!
Four!
Five!
Six!
Seven!
Eight!
Oops, too many! Drag one off the pizza.
That's the order!
Cut it in half! Drag across the pizza.
Two halves!
Drag all the way across the pizza!

text: One half for me, one for my baby!

Tap the pizza to serve it!

text: Ciao! Half mushrooms, half olives, please!
I made this one for you. Watch!

Mushrooms go on this half!
Olives go on that half!
Put mushrooms on one half and olives on the other!
Cut it into four slices! Two cuts!
Now cut the other way!
Four slices!

text: Four slices, for me and my friends!

When someone says grazie, you say prego!

text: Now make a pizza just for YOU, Chef Kaylee!

Red sauce or pink sauce?
Red tomato sauce!
Pink beet sauce! Yum!
Put on anything you like!
Uh oh! Tap the sneaky cat!
Tap the check when you like it!
Cut it any way you like!
Mozzarella!
Basil!
Olive!
Mushroom!
Peperoni! In Italy, that means peppers!
Tomato!
Great job, Chef Kaylee!

text: Grazie, Chef Kaylee! A chef hat for you!
And my mandolin, for Lupa's band!
Yay! Our first friend for the band!
Ciao, Kaylee! The olives are ready!
Help me pick them for olive oil!

Drag the rake along the glowing branch!
Now comb this branch!
One more branch!
Slide the rake all the way to the end!

text: Eek! They stuck on my quills!

Tap Spina to shake them off!
Olives in the net!
Great combing, Kaylee!
The net is full!
Olive trees love hot, dry, sunny summers!
This olive is green. Tap the sun!
Purple! Tap the sun again!
Black! Now it is ripe!
Put them in order! Green, then purple, then black!
Green goes in the one sun bowl!
Purple goes in the two sun bowl!
Black goes in the three sun bowl!
Green, purple, black! Well done, Kaylee!
Fresh olives are too bitter! They have to soak first.

text: Welcome to the frantoio, the olive mill!

Drop ten olives in the big funnel!
Drag an olive up to the funnel, or tap the basket!
Nine!
Ten!
It takes lots of olives to make oil!
Here comes the big stone wheel!
Look! Golden olive oil!
Hold the jug to pour! Fill it all the way!
Full! All the way to the top!
Now fill it halfway, to the dotted line!
A little more! Up to the dotted line!
Half! Halfway full!
Olive oil goes on almost everything in Italy!

text: Bruschetta for everyone! Bread with olive oil!
And my tambourine, for Lupa's band!

Tap the tambourine!

text: Yay! A tambourine for the band!
Oh no! The Trevi Fountain is dry!

Tap the hill and listen!
Tap the rocks!
Long ago, a girl helped the Romans find water.
Today, that girl is YOU, Kaylee!
Build a water bridge to Rome!
Drag the arch that fits each gap!
Water only flows downhill!
Try the glowing arch!
Now tap an arch!
Now all the way to Rome! Look closely!
The Romans called a water bridge an aqueduct!
Tap the spring to turn on the water!
Follow the water with your finger!

text: The water is going to Rome!

The Romans built this water bridge 2,000 years ago!
And it still fills the fountain today!
Flick the coin up into the fountain!
Swipe up on the coin!
One more coin!
Now you will come back to Rome one day, Kaylee!
A wishing star! It will wait for Lupa's big night.
Coins from the fountain help people who need it.
Brown bear sticker! Bears live in the mountains of Italy!
Porcupine sticker! Crested porcupines live in Italy!
Wolf sticker! The story says a kind mama wolf took care of the twins who built Rome!
Let's see how olive oil is made!
Let's toss a coin in the real Trevi Fountain!
Look! A real Roman water bridge!
In Italy, people say ciao! It means hello and goodbye!
Grazie means thank you!
One, two, three in Italian: uno, due, tre!
Italy is shaped like a boot, kicking a ball!
Italy has hot, sunny summers, and snowy mountains up north!
Pizza comes from Naples, in Italy!
Pizza Margherita is red, white and green, like Italy's flag!
Long ago, the Romans built roads, arenas and water bridges!
Italy has volcanoes! One is right next to Naples!
Italy's flag has three stripes: green, white and red!
Some olive trees in Italy are more than a thousand years old!
The story says a kind mama wolf took care of the twins who built Rome!
This is Italy! Tap a picture to learn more.
